name: Aureskomest
backstory: Child of Aurekomest and Aurelkhau; raised in Gorff on works out of the temple's own records annex..., and carries some knowledge of Birth Of Forliukar.

experience.text: Grew up hearing: Grew up hearing: Learned that Khaubalo has died.
Grew up hearing: Had a child with Aurekomest, named Aurelkomest.

criterion.standard: measures a life by whether Temple Of The Crossing is still remembered rightly
criterion.wasted_life: forgetting what Temple Of The Crossing actually meant, the way most people already have
criterion.trusts: a story that's been carried and retold and still holds together
criterion.distrusts: a record that insists on a precision no one who was actually there ever needed

arc.premise: Aureskomest wants to settle, from the annex's own oldest entries, who actually built the temple first - the question her own criterion already measures her life against, and one she's better placed than most to actually check.
